scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs with a fixed number r>=3 of nonempty parts. The analytic proof is complete; finite computation is only corroborative. The closest inspected complete-multipartite spectral paper optimizes spectral radius/energy, not lambda_1+lambda_N. A residual originality risk is an older equivalent statement indexed under different adjacency-spectrum terminology. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp minimum spectral bipartiteness of complete multipartite graphs
